proposition: Melvin-Koushki's Prologue gives the order of the three Globes three ways: Pearl-Peach-Planet (with Written-Spoken-Mental) on p.8, 'or rather' Planet-Pearl-Peach on p.9, and Pearl-Planet-Peach in the footnote on the word ʿabd on p.11; only the p.9 order matches the dissertation's section order (mental, written, spoken).
